description: Get a legacy Insight-signed settlement evidence record for a resolved prediction-market price contract: stated outcome versus the independently observed outcome, bps deltas, coverage and a descriptive consistency grade. This describes a market that has already settled. It is NOT a safety assessment and NOT advice about any live configuration. For a signed, advisory, independently recomputable oracle configuration record, use POST /api/v1/oracle-config/snapshot. Pass slug for one market, or omit it to list recent packs. Derived analytics only; raw venue candles are not distributed.

slug.description: Polymarket market slug, e.g. btc-updown-5m-1766162100. Omit to list recent packs

name: get_settlement_evidence
